name: Memphis Jr.
summary: Memphis Jr. was the children's version of Memphis Design .
description:
Memphis Jr. was the children's version of Memphis Design . It took the popular Memphis-Milano style created by the Italian architecture and design firm Memphis Group and applied it to storefronts, advertisements, and toys marketed towards young children. Memphis Jr. was most popular during the late 1980s to the mid 90s, until it was eventually replaced by newer child-focused aesthetics like Wacky Pomo .

Influenced by the eccentric forms and bold colors of Radical Design , this aesthetic is characterized by vibrant colors, geometric shapes, contrasting patterns on bright backgrounds, and patterns like stripes and squiggles.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Playfulness, creativity, childhood
